title: AI Admin Organizer
businessOutcomes: Trackers stay current without manual retyping.
summary: Keep operational trackers current by extracting action items from emails and updating spreadsheet rows automatically.
businessProblem: Quote trackers, invoice follow-up lists, and task spreadsheets fall behind because updating them requires manual data entry from emails and conversations nobody has time for.
outcome: Spreadsheet trackers stay current: new quote requests added, overdue items flagged, and status columns updated from email content — without manual entry.
expectedOutcomes: Spreadsheet trackers stay current: new quote requests added, overdue items flagged, and status columns updated from email content — without manual entry.
whoItsFor: Operators who run their business on Google Sheets or Airtable and spend hours each week copying information from emails into trackers.
aiInputs: Incoming emails matching tracker criteria (quotes, invoices, orders)
Current spreadsheet rows and column schema
Rules for what constitutes a new row vs. update to existing row
aiOutputs: New rows appended to tracker with extracted fields
Status updates on existing rows (e.g., 'Quote sent' → 'Awaiting reply')
Overdue item flags based on date columns
Daily summary of changes made to the tracker
noCodeTools: Zapier: new email with label → ChatGPT extract → Sheets append row
Google Apps Script + OpenAI for custom sheet automation
Airtable AI field for email parsing
lowCodeTools: n8n: Gmail trigger → OpenAI structured extraction → Sheets update
customBuildStack: Gmail API polling for labeled emails
OpenAI structured output (JSON) for field extraction
Google Sheets API for row append/update
implementationSteps: Define tracker schema: columns, valid status values, date fields
Set email rules: which messages trigger tracker updates
Map email fields to sheet columns with AI extraction prompt
Run in log-only mode first — AI reports what it would change without writing
Enable writes after 1 week of accurate log-only runs
Review daily change summary for extraction errors
systemBehavior: Runs on email arrival or daily batch scan
Appends new rows — never deletes existing data
Updates status columns only when extraction confidence is high
Flags ambiguous extractions for human review instead of guessing
Sends daily summary of all changes made
risks: AI may misparse email and create duplicate or incorrect rows
Concurrent human edits and automation cause data conflicts
Wrong status updates on invoice tracker could cause missed collections
Email extraction errors are hard to spot without daily review habit
